subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw expose a public `resetSession(reason?)` capability specifically on successful, resettable `after_compaction` hook contexts?
rationale: This is a new plugin API and policy capability, not only an internal bug repair; code review can validate safety but cannot decide whether session rotation belongs in the supported hook contract.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
options.body: Approve the after-compaction-only, canonical-current-session, deferred contract after the successor-session defect and proof gap are resolved.

options.title: Keep reset core-owned
options.body: Do not expose reset through plugin hook contexts and instead implement required compaction recovery as core or context-engine policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Approve the after-compaction-only, canonical-current-session, deferred contract after the successor-session defect and proof gap are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The context-engine compaction integration is the closest existing ownership trail for deciding where post-compaction recovery policy belongs.
